title: Screening and Follow-up Study of Neonatal Jaundice Based on Mobile Network
brief_summary: At least 13 hospitals in China will participate in the study, which aims to clarify the natural history of jaundice in Chinese healthy newborns，and decrease the incidence of severe hyperbilirubinemia and acute bilirubin encephalopathy and even kernicterus. The study is an open project, and the investigators welcome institutions fulfilling the specified requirements to join the study during the recruitment phase.
inclusion_criteria:
inclusion criteria: 

 Term or near-term neonates with gestational age ≥35w and birth weight ≥2000g.
exclusion_criteria:
: 

 Biliary atresia, serious genetic and metabolic diseases, family history of epilepsy, and so on.
